label: Confirmed Deaths
contestNote: Toll rose steadily from 2 (15 Aug) to 73 (19 Aug) to 83 (21 Aug) to 91 (23 Aug) to 100 (24 Aug) to 103 (25 Aug) to 105 (26 Aug) to 111 (27 Aug), then held flat through 28, 29, 30 and 31 Aug (Day 17) with no new fatalities reported for a fifth straight day. BNPB says many recent additions were indirect earthquake impacts (shock, falls, aftershock-triggered cardiac events) or hospitalized victims who could not be saved, rather than fresh structural-collapse fatalities.

label: Injured
contestNote: BNPB's 30 August 07:00 WIB tally of 1,631 (223 severe, 1,408 minor) is down from 1,672 (27 Aug) and remained the latest published figure through 31 August; the injured count has swung both up and down across reporting days as regency-level tallies are reconciled and some cases are discharged or reclassified.

label: Displaced / Sheltering
contestNote: Displacement fell 4,142 to 188,161 on the 30 August 07:00 WIB count, but that is a net rise from 176,621 (27 Aug) because a 29 August data-validation pass sharply revised Nagekeo Regency's evacuee count upward (from roughly 3,259 to 21,552), not because of new displacement. Manggarai (50,556) and Nagekeo (50,574) are now the largest concentrations.
delta: -4,142 on 30 Aug; +11,540 net since 27 Aug (data revision)

label: Homes Damaged
contestNote: BNPB's 30 August tally of 95,567 (27,414 severe, 21,992 moderate, 46,161 light) is sharply up from 77,912 (27 Aug) as verification expanded to more regencies. BNPB says 27,414 families with severely damaged homes urgently need temporary shelter or relocation. Figures remain preliminary pending completion of by-name-by-address verification.

label: Aftershocks Recorded
deltaNote: M1.0–M6.2 range; 8,193+ recorded by 27 August, passing 9,765 by 30 August and 10,232 by 31 August 05:00 WITA (35 events ≥M5.0, 157 felt by residents). BMKG says the decay curve has begun showing a clearer declining pattern, though activity is still expected to continue for another 3-4 weeks from the mainshock.

label: Presidential Visit Status
deltaNote: Twice-postponed visit finally took place on Day 11 (26 Aug); Prabowo distributed Rp200 billion in aid at a Nagekeo Regency command post.

label: Personnel Deployed
delta: 5,832 TNI + 238 Polri + 903 volunteers as of 22-23 Aug (up from 3,500+ TNI/Polri on 17 Aug)

label: State of Emergency
deltaNote: Governor Emanuel Melkiades Laka Lena extended the province-wide emergency response status by 14 days beyond its original 28 August expiry, citing forecast aftershock activity continuing another 2-3 weeks; Nagekeo Regency received a separate 3-month extension.

label: Mainshock Magnitude
contestNote: GFZ Potsdam measured Mw 7.61 at 25 km depth vs. USGS/BMKG's M7.7 at 10 km; BMKG's own first report was M7.0 before revising upward.

label: Schools Damaged
source: Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education (Kemendikdasmen)
contestNote: Kemendikdasmen's assessment as of 31 August found 1,918 education units affected across seven regencies and 97 sub-districts (up from BNPB's earlier 1,378 partial count on 21 August), including 665 schools severely damaged, affecting roughly 141,207 students. Only 37 schools had resumed in-person emergency learning and 295 were on distance learning as of 31 August.

label: Aid Distributed (Cumulative)
deltaNote: Delivered via TNI AU airlift (565t + a further 21t on 30 Aug), the Ready-to-Use Fund (1,065t), sea transport (179t) and overland trucking (145t); reaching distribution hubs in Maumere and Labuan Bajo. Separately, the Air Force said its Halim Perdanakusuma-coordinated relief airlift — 729 tons of food and clothing via C-130 Hercules and A400M aircraft — was winding down after a 15-day operation.
